ayuda: Prepare a requirement review checklist from synthetic JSON. Use --idioma and --catalogos-dir to select the catalogue. Read the material from standard input. The output keeps unresolved reasons; it does not decide admission or register a correction.
seleccion.admision.entrada_invalida: The review could not be prepared. Check the format, references and versions of the supplied material.
seleccion.admision.salida_no_disponible: The result could not be written. Check the destination and prepare it again.
seleccion.admision.causa.fuentes_no_veri: The source and correspondence of the material remain unverified.
seleccion.admision.causa.texto_libre: The requirement is expressed as text. Its interpretation needs competent review.
seleccion.admision.causa.regla_ausente: A versioned rule reference is missing for this requirement.
seleccion.admision.causa.evaluador_pendi: The proposed rule needs an evaluator accepted under the applicable terms.
seleccion.admision.causa.dato_no_aportad: Data or supporting references are missing for this review.
seleccion.admision.causa.acreditacion_pe: The supplied status or evidence needs verification review.
seleccion.admision.causa.rechazo_aplicab: The supplied rejection needs review of its application to this requirement.
seleccion.admision.causa.vigencia_aplica: The supplied dates do not cover the proposed milestone. Review their application under the applicable terms.
seleccion.admision.accion.preparar_aport: Prepare data or evidence for review
seleccion.admision.accion.preparar_revis: Prepare review of the requirement and its support
seleccion.admision.pendiente.bases_unive: Check the applicable terms and the complete requirement list.
seleccion.admision.pendiente.corresponde: Check correspondence with the application. The local summary remains unsubmitted.
seleccion.admision.pendiente.lectura_aut: Obtain minimum facts through an authorised query to their owners.
seleccion.admision.pendiente.identidad_r: Check identity, registered submission and documents through the competent procedure.
seleccion.admision.pendiente.subsanacion: Determine which items may be corrected and under what conditions before issuing a request.
seleccion.admision.pendiente.aprobacion_: Give reasons for decisions and obtain competent approval before publishing lists.
